import os
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace')

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(j for row in grid for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    blocks = []
    for c in colors:
        cells = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == c]
        r0,r1=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells)
        c0,c1=min(j for i,j in cells),max(j for i,j in cells)
        blocks.append([[c if grid[i][j] == c else 0 for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(sum(len(b[0]) for b in blocks))] for _ in range(max(map(len,blocks)))]
    x=0
    for b in blocks:
        y=(len(out)-len(b))//2
        for i,row in enumerate(b): out[y+i][x:x+len(row)] = row
        x += len(b[0])
    return out
'''
